classificationMethod.COMPLETED_OR_SUPERSEDED: Used for a row whose OWN content is a founder decision, ruling, adjudication or executed demolition that is finished, or a record now superseded. It is never used to imply that work chartered elsewhere in the same RC chapter is finished, and never used because a related finding is closed.
classificationMethod.PARTIALLY_COMPLETED: Used where the row's own record states partial state - most often C0's and C1's four-dimension completeness record (ARCHITECTURE complete / RUNTIME ADOPTION partial / VISIBLE PRODUCT ADOPTION partial / LEGACY RETIREMENT partial), or where a built authority still has measured unconverted consumers.
classificationMethod.OUTSTANDING_CONSTRUCTION: Used where the row names a system, demolition, conversion or capability that does not exist or is not executed. Includes rows whose own measurement states zero implementations.
classificationMethod.FOUNDER_ACTION_ONLY: Used for founderCheckpoints scope rows, disposition decisions, deferred commercial boundaries and vocabulary the founder deliberately reserved. Engineering may not supply these and may not proceed past them.
classificationMethod.VALIDATION_OR_GATE_ONLY: Used for every CHARTERED_SCOPE:preserve row. A preserve obligation's remaining work is to not break the item and to prove it was not broken - that is regression/gate work, not construction. All 32 preserve rows in this range carry this class.
classificationMethod.UNKNOWN: Not used in this range. No row in RC-C0..RC-C5 required an UNKNOWN state on the evidence available, and no row was moved OUT of UNKNOWN - none arrived in that state. The founder ruling that UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN applies to RC-C10's 21 obligations in the B-set, not here.

unassignableNote: Zero. Every one of the 164 obligations found a chapter in the FIXED set whose governing outcome genuinely contains it. CO-RC-C3-014 CLASSIFICATION IS DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE. 'Room for a universal Find/Go-To' is literally satisfied by the frozen IA not foreclosing it, which would argue COMPLETED; the capability itself does not exist, which would argue OUTSTANDING. PARTIALLY_COMPLETED is recorded so the unbuilt capability stays visible without the row being read as authorising an unchartered build. The alternative readings are preserved.

FROZEN_OUTCOME ROWS CLASSED COMPLETED_OR_SUPERSEDED MUST NOT BE READ AS SHIPPED PRODUCT. 36 rows in this range are frozen founder decisions. Classing the DECISION as complete says nothing about the SYSTEM it governs - for example CO-RC-C4-001/002/003 are complete as decisions while the entire attention hub they describe is OUTSTANDING_CONSTRUCTION under CO-RC-C4-013..021. This is the single largest misreading risk in this artifact.

CO-RC-C5-004 IS TYPED FROZEN_OUTCOME BUT CLASSED OUTSTANDING_CONSTRUCTION. Its own measurement states 0 drag-and-drop implementations and it is a founder-surfaced obligation the discovery audit missed. Classing it as a completed freeze would have hidden an entirely unbuilt authority behind a type label. The type/class divergence is deliberate and recorded.

ALL 32 PRESERVE ROWS CLASSED VALIDATION_OR_GATE_ONLY. This is a methodological choice, not evidence that each preserved item is currently intact. Several preserves sit under heavy rebuild (CO-RC-C5-021 drafts under a six-composer collapse; CO-RC-C5-025 working media rendering under a presentation rebuild; CO-RC-C3-022 all deep links under a route demolition) and are the load-bearing regression gates of their chapters.

TWO UNRECONCILED CERTIFICATION VOCABULARIES REACH THIS ARTIFACT. Because the RC layer table and the section 12/17 validation classes are not reconciled (CH-17 owns the reconciliation), any statement here that an RC chapter is 'closed' is not interchangeable with a certification claim. CO-RC-C0-014 and CO-RC-C1-011 are the explicit four-dimension records that make this visible.

The 14 protected Meetings spinners are inside CH-01's measured debt row while the Meetings-preserved rule forbids modifying certified Meetings for foundation debt reduction. 296 OF 299 OBLIGATIONS HAVE ZERO FINDING COVERAGE, AND ALL 164 IN THIS RANGE DO. No row in this artifact is supported by, sized by, or closed by a finding. A chapter owning only chartered work here is normal and is not evidence of an empty chapter.

notes.methodOwnershipTest: RULE 2 governs: an obligation is owned by the chapter that must DO it or PROVE it. RULE 3 (frozen outcome to the chapter owning the frozen authority), RULE 4 (preserve to the chapter that would otherwise break it), RULE 5 (historical item to the chapter continuing that item's work) and RULE 6 (founder checkpoint to the chapter that may not proceed past it) were applied as recorded in chapter-architecture.json, and the coverageAssuranceByRcChapter distribution was honoured exactly.
notes.historicalItemSplits: Four historical items are split across two owners each and both halves are recorded: Item 4 (CO-RC-C1-020 acting half in CH-01 / CO-RC-C2-033 identity half in CH-03), Item 6 (CO-RC-C0-023 temporal half in CH-01 / CO-RC-C4-028 timeline half in CH-05), Item 3 (CO-RC-C4-027 client half in CH-05 / RC-C9 native half in CH-16, B-set), drag/drop (CO-RC-C5-009 intake in CH-13 / CO-RC-C9-011 platform in CH-16, B-set). No half subsumes the other.
notes.productStandard: Where a preserve or a completed decision still leaves an inadequate product, the inadequacy survives as construction rather than being absorbed. CO-RC-C5-025 (working media rendering preserved) is a floor beneath CH-13's world-class presentation obligations, not a substitute for them; CO-RC-C5-023 accessibility preserve is a floor beneath WG015 enforced as definition-of-done.
